resources.string: Get a notification when a station near you reports a price at or under your limit. While alerts are on, OpenFuel checks your location in the background every so often. Prices are unverified community reports.
Notify me about cheap fuel nearby
Allow notifications so OpenFuel can send alerts.
Allow location access so OpenFuel can find stations near you.
Alerts need location while the app is closed. On the next screen, choose “Allow all the time”.
Less often uses less battery. Android may delay checks while the phone is idle.
Only prices reported in the last day
%1$s has %2$s ¢/L, %3$s away. Notifications are off, so no alert was sent.
No station within %3$s reports %1$s at or under %2$s ¢/L right now.
Your location isn’t available right now. Try again in a moment.

Each check sends your location, rounded to about 100 m, to OpenFuel to look up nearby stations, as a map search does. Neither the location nor the results are saved. The same price at the same station is announced at most once a day.
